questions.question: The list headed “published in the USSR” includes a 1998 collection. Approve “The following works appeared in Russian…” and the corresponding Russian wording while retaining that edition.

localizations.source: The list headed “published in the USSR” includes a 1998 collection. Approve “The following works appeared in Russian…” and the corresponding Russian wording while retaining that edition.
localizations.ru: В перечне под заголовком «В СССР были опубликованы» есть сборник 1998 года. Согласовать общее вступление «На русском языке были опубликованы…» / “The following works appeared in Russian…” без удаления издания.

questions.resolution: The introduction now describes the Russian-language editions, including the 1998 collection.
